planner_decisions.V1-D1_superseded_request: a second submit aborts the pending ask (superseded flag, then ctl.abort()); the aborted ask ends {superseded:true} and verbAct does nothing with it (no message, no panel, no navigation, input untouched); the newer ask answers explicitly within its own budget. Timeout differs: say('the verb route did not answer in time'). A superseded ask can never navigate (abort races both awaits; an answer that beat the abort is dropped too).
planner_decisions.V1-D2_vp2_clock: askVerb(raw, io) takes fetch/AbortController/setTimeout/clearTimeout; the node harness injects a controlled clock that records (fn, ms) and fires on demand; ms === VERB_ROUTE_BUDGET_MS === 15000 asserted. The budget is a named constant, exported read-only, NOT a tunable (no knob can make the wait unbounded; the server's own bound is 10 s).
